She said to them, “Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.

people.name: Marah
people.line: A place with bitter water on the Exodus route

translations.web: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.
translations.bsb: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink the water there because it was bitter. (That is why it was named Marah.)
translations.kjv: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
translations.asv: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
